executive_assessment.text: Evidence distinguishes Danube/Siret flood exposure, coastal planning weaknesses in Constanța County and southern/southeastern agricultural drought sensitivity.
Historical flood-plan delivery and coordination gaps, and lower indexed adaptive capacity in eastern regions, identify institutional constraints rather than violent conflict.

The UCPM profile's conflict-risk projection lacks a specified mediator and is not expanded into a pathway. Municipal and meadow-restoration initiatives remain reported capacities, not proven outcomes.

geographic_notes.text: Source dated 2026-03-16 reports: In Romania's Danube Basin, about 25% of the population and 8% of territory are flood-exposed; Danube and Siret floods peak in spring and early summer.
Source dated 2026-03-16 reports: OECD describes urban expansion in Constanța County coastal towns without sufficient elevation or drainage upgrades despite known pluvial and coastal flood risks.
Source dated 2023-12-18 reports: Romania cited Alba Iulia's municipal plan as good practice and reported two regions joining the EU Adaptation Mission.

The EU Adaptation Mission portal describes meadow-restoration projects covering 40 hectares in Râu Sadului and Cristian, using drones to address drought, biodiversity loss and erosion. The short project account does not establish completed restoration or measured resilience gains.

known_gaps.text: Automated machine-screening is not independent source verification. Routine/default app-use approval does not certify claims or sources. 18 of 18 evidence records and 0 of 0 pathways lack claim-level verification in this remediation; review the linked records before relying on them.
No directly read primary source established an FCV-to-climate-adaptation mechanism for Romania; search results on displacement were leads only.
The UCPM profile's climate-scenario statement that conflict risk may rise provides no conflict mechanism, model details or uncertainty bounds; it is retained only as that source-stated projection.
The linked full Romania CCDR and the 2026 European Commission country-report PDF could not be directly accessed; their indexed text was excluded.
The ICPDR Danube Delta publisher page returned 403; its indexed summary was excluded from evidence.
